_comment: The report's rows, in display order. 'name' and 'description' are the user-facing copy for the first two report columns. The Python engine (engine/extract.py) returns one result per 'key'; tests/test_extract.py fails if the two ever drift apart.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Document title stored in the file's properties.

fields.name: Author
fields.description: Person or organization recorded as the document's author.

fields.name: Subject
fields.description: Subject line stored in the file's properties.

fields.name: Keywords
fields.description: Search keywords stored in the file's properties.

fields.name: Creator Application
fields.description: Software that created the original document before it became a PDF.

fields.name: Producer Application
fields.description: Software library or print driver that wrote the PDF file.

fields.name: Created Date
fields.description: Date and time the PDF was created.

fields.name: Modified Date
fields.description: Date and time the PDF was last modified.

fields.name: Page Count
fields.description: Number of pages in the file.

fields.name: Page Size(s)
fields.description: Sheet dimensions of each page. Mixed sheet sizes are flagged.

fields.name: Page Units
fields.description: Base unit of the page coordinate system. The PDF default is 1/72 inch (one point).

fields.name: Layer List
fields.description: Named layers (optional content groups) embedded in the file, such as CAD layers from AutoCAD or Revit exports.

fields.name: Layer Visibility & Print Flags
fields.description: Whether each layer is shown and printed by default when the file is opened.

fields.name: Tagged Object Properties
fields.description: Object data attached to drawing elements, such as Category, Family, Type, Level, and Mark.

fields.name: Bluebeam Custom Properties
fields.description: User-defined document properties, such as those added in Bluebeam Revu or Acrobat.

fields.name: Bluebeam Custom Columns
fields.description: User-defined Markups List columns and the values stored on each markup.

fields.name: Bluebeam Saved Measurements/Spaces
fields.description: Length, area, count, and space markups with their stored measured values.

fields.name: Embedded Scale
fields.description: Drawing scale stored in the file's measure dictionary, present when scale was calibrated in Acrobat or Bluebeam.

fields.name: GeoPDF Registration
fields.description: Geographic coordinate system and control points that tie the drawing to real-world locations.

fields.name: Bookmarks/Outline
fields.description: The document's bookmark tree (table of contents).

fields.name: Hyperlinks
fields.description: Clickable links, both internal (sheet to sheet) and external (web addresses and other files).

fields.name: Form Fields
fields.description: Fillable form fields and their current values.

fields.name: Annotations/Comments/Markups
fields.description: Comments and markups placed on the pages, such as notes, text boxes, clouds, and shapes.

fields.name: Attachments
fields.description: Files embedded inside the PDF.

fields.name: Fonts Used/Embedded
fields.description: Fonts referenced by the pages. Fonts that are not embedded may display differently on other computers.

fields.name: Image Inventory
fields.description: Raster images embedded in the pages.

fields.name: Permissions/Restrictions
fields.description: Actions the file restricts, such as printing, copying, or editing.

fields.name: Encryption Status
fields.description: Whether the file is encrypted, which method is used, and whether a password is needed to open it.
